_read_me: Copy to docs/STAFF_APPROVAL.json (gitignored: it names people) and fill in. publish_city_site.py refuses to publish the City staff site without a responsible adult, a corrections contact and a sunset date at most a year away. Every other section left empty is shown to staff, in plain words, as not done. Every date is YYYY-MM-DD and counts only on or before the day of publishing: leave a section empty until the event has happened (a scheduled meeting or vote is not on record, and neither is "soon" or "tbd"). A section filled in but not counted is named in the publish's warnings. See docs/STAFF_SITE.md.

responsible_adult.relationship: parent, teacher advisor, or mentor (18 or older, not an author)

corrections_contact._note: a role address the responsible adult controls, not a student's personal address

city_requestor._note: who at the City asked, in writing, for access, and the date they asked (YYYY-MM-DD, on or before the day of publishing); the name and the date are both needed before any staff sign-in sees the named list. Title and office are for the record

trust_determination._note: the City's answer: result "does not apply" or "applies" (SDMC 210.0101-210.0112), by: who at the City gave it, and date: when (YYYY-MM-DD, on or before the day of publishing). All three are needed; a result without by and date is not counted. If it applies, Privacy Advisory Board review and a Council vote come first: record the vote in council_approval

council_approval._note: only when the TRUST Ordinance applies: the resolution approving this use and the date of the Council's vote (YYYY-MM-DD, on or before the day of publishing). Both are needed; a vote still to come is not an approval

legal_review._note: a lawyer's review of naming these businesses to City staff

county_informed._note: when the County was shown this list, and what it said

owner_notice._note: when the businesses on the list were told it exists, and how
